Bldgs. 39 & 40 PARTY WALL DECLARATION OF RESTRICTIONS, made as of this 15th day of July, 2002, by Landmark Projects IV, Inc.,having offices at 250 Park Avenue South, New York, NY 10003 (hereinafter referred to as the “Developer") and NYC Partnership Housing Development Fund Company, Inc., having offices at One Battery Park Plaza, New York, New York 10004, (hereinafter referred to as the “NYCP") (Developer and NYCP are hereinafter collectively referred to as the“Declarants"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, NYCP is the owner of the real property in borough of Manhattan as described on Schedule“A"Block 1726part ofLot5 tentative Lot 4 and Block 1726 part of Lot 5, New York, NY, annexed hereto and made a part hereof, upon which Developer intends to build two new threefamily-four story townhouses; WHEREAS, the Developer has built two residential buildings in such a manner that each of the buildings shall adjoin the other and shall be connected to each other by a common Party Wall ("Party Wall"); WHEREAStheDeclarantsdesiretodeclarethefollowingrestrictions,covenants and agreements governing said Party Wall; and WHEREAS, the home designated as Block 1726, part of Lot 5 tentative Lot 4 is located at street address 83 West 128th Street, NewYork,N.Y.and the home on the other side of thePartyWall is designated as Block 1726,part of Lot 5 and is located at street address 81.West 128th Street,NewYork,NY; NOW THEREFORE, the following declaration of restrictions, covenants and agreements shall run with the land and be binding upon the Declarants herein, their heirs, successors and assigns and shall run with the land and be binding upon each successive owner of Block 1726 part of Lot 5 tentativeLot 4 and of Block 1726partof Lot 5, New York, N.Y. and the heirs, successors and assigns of each such subsequent owner. 1. The PartyWall was constructed in such a fashion as to be located an equal distance on or over the respective adjoining lots with the midline of the Party Wall being located as nearly as possible on the common boundary line and it is understood that minor variations may be present due to topographical problems or construction requirements. 2. ThePartyWall shall be used and maintained as a PartyWall forever and the owner of the lot on each sideof thePartyWall,shall belicensed and permitted to enter upon the premises of the owner on the other side of the Party Wall to make necessary repairs upon advance notification to said adjoining owner of such intentions to do so.
